title: Evaluating Machine Learning Models
summary: Uses eICU-style data to walk through clinical preprocessing, exploratory analysis, univariate analysis, and multivariate evaluation.
guide_notes: Mention that bundled eICU demo data is used before remote fallback.
Explain odds ratios, AUROC, and subgroup comparisons in clinical terms.
Help learners interpret metric trade-offs rather than only maximizing one score.
